scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi Social Security Scheme For Poor Families - 2012
other_conditions: Beneficiary cannot claim any other scheme benefits simultaneously.
Claim must be submitted within 180 days of death or accident.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of ₹30,000 for natural death, ₹75,000 for unnatural death or permanent total disability, and ₹37,500 for partial total disability.
